title: [main] Ship to address Var/protected var fix
summary: The Ship-to Address table had a label text accidentally moved when a variable was changed from Var to Protected Var, which has been corrected.
key_points: PostCode variable was moved from Var to Protected Var in the Ship-to Address table
Label Text000 was unintentionally moved along with the variable
The label has been restored to its correct location
Change applied to W1, NA, and RU layers
Fix resolves an issue introduced on the main branch
quote: When PostCode variable moved from Var to Protected Var, Label Text000 is also moved accidently.
